intro: Nepal is a federal parliamentary republic under a constitution adopted in 2015.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament chooses the prime minister; the president is head of state. There are seven provinces. Coalitions change often, and Nepal has had many prime ministers since 2008.

chapters.title: Gen Z protests
text: In September 2025, protests sparked by a social media ban forced the government out. Former chief justice Sushila Karki became interim prime minister ahead of new elections.

keyTerms.meaning: Temporary, until something permanent is arranged.
